source_title: Solution-Processable ZnO Thin Film Memristive Device for Resistive Random Access Memory Application
notes: Bipolar switching; 100 switching cycles; retention >100 s without observable degradation; 300 us read/write pulses; ZnO film thickness 34 um; crystallite size 62 nm
state_count_notes: Paper explicitly reports two distinct and well-resolved resistance states: HRS and LRS.

source_title: Modeling and Simulation of Correlated Cycle-to-Cycle Variability in the Current-Voltage Hysteresis Loops of RRAM Devices
notes: 10 nm HfO2; device area 5x5 um2; experimental 100-cycle I-V data; sweep 0 to +1.3 to -1.3 to 0 V; forming near 3.5 V; HRS/LRS evaluated at -0.2 V; correlated cycle-to-cycle variability; RON/ROFF and ON/OFF ratio are approximate values derived from the experimental mean-current dashed lines in Figure 9 of DOI 10.1109/TNANO.2024.3485213 at -0.2 V (LRS ~3.59 mA, HRS ~0.079 mA). GRADUAL_MULTILEVEL behavior is supported by the same-stack multilevel study DOI 10.1016/j.mee.2017.11.007. The figure-derived electrical values are approximate and must not be described as directly tabulated.
state_count_notes: The 2024 primary study evaluates HRS and LRS as the two extreme conduction states but does not report a fixed physical conductance-state count. A 2018 same-stack TiN/Ti/HfO2/W study experimentally demonstrates multilevel conductance tuning, but no single fixed state count is imposed here.

source_title: Stochastic switching of TiO2-based memristive devices with identical initial memory states
notes: 31 nm TiO2; active area 5x5 um2; initial resistance about 8 Mohm; unipolar switching; programming pulse 4 V for 10 us; read pulse 0.5 V for 1 us; stochastic switching between nominally identical cells
state_count_notes: Paper demonstrates stochastic switching between HRS and LRS but does not report a fixed physical conductance-state count; identical measured resistance can correspond to different filament distributions.

source_title: Physics-based compact modelling of the analog dynamics of HfOx resistive memories
notes: 5.5 nm HfO2; experimental analog and binary switching; TiN/Ti/HfO2/TiN; maximum resistance window slightly above 5; 300-pulse programming experiments; bipolar switching; experimental variability characterized
state_count_notes: Paper reports gradual multilevel analog resistance dynamics under weak pulse programming; no fixed conductance-state count is reported.

source_title: "Quantized conductance coincides with state instability and excess noise in tantalum oxide memristors"
notes: 10-18 nm TaOx; 100000 ON/OFF switching cycles; RON and ROFF derived from reported mean conductances GON=3.67e-2 S and GOFF=7.06e-5 S; quantized conductance states; strong excess noise near conductance quantum
state_count_notes: Device switches continuously; integer-multiple quantized conductance appears only in an intermediate regime and is unstable/noisy, so no fixed stable conductance-state count is assigned.

source_title: Ferroelectric, Analog Resistive Switching in Back-End-of-Line Compatible TiN/HfZrO4/TiOx Junctions
notes: BEOL-compatible ferroelectric analog resistive memory; 4.5 nm HfZrO4 and 3.5 nm TiOx layers; 100 mV non-destructive read-out; reversible gradual SET/RESET with intermediate resistance states; after ferroelectric wake-up the reported ON/OFF ratio increases from 1.3 to 2.0. The profile uses the post-wake-up ON/OFF=2.0 regime. Absolute RON/ROFF are not inserted, so the simulator must use normalized conductance from the reported ratio.
state_count_notes: The study demonstrates intermediate resistance states and analog reversible switching, including states reached by switching only a fraction of ferroelectric domains, but it does not report a fixed physical conductance-state count.

source_title: Mimicking Synaptic Behaviors with Cross-Point Structured TiOx/TiOy-Based Filamentary RRAM for Neuromorphic Applications
notes: Cross-point TiOx/TiOy bilayer filamentary RRAM for neuromorphic synaptic operation. Reported active area 20 x 20 um^2. Electroforming occurs at approximately 5.62 V. Reported ON/OFF ratio is approximately 76 at 0.2 V. LTP/LTD and STDP are demonstrated. The related 2018 thesis for the same experimental platform reports gradual conductance modulation and 50 protocol-generated conductance values under a 50-pulse LTP/LTD experiment. Those 50 values are NOT treated as a fixed intrinsic physical state count. Absolute RON/ROFF are not inserted, so normalized conductance from ratio is required.
state_count_notes: Gradual multi-level behavior is experimentally demonstrated. The related thesis reports 50 different conductance values during a 50-pulse LTP/LTD protocol, but this is a programming-protocol outcome rather than a reported fixed intrinsic state capacity. Therefore no fixed physical state count is imposed.
